children: Lifecore announced its board set November 4, 2026 as the record date for a special meeting to vote on the previously announced merger agreement.
Board established Nov. 4, 2026 as record date for special meeting to approve adoption of the Merger Agreement.
Stockholders of record on that date will be entitled to notice of and to vote at the Special Meeting.
Company will file a preliminary and later a definitive proxy statement with the SEC in connection with the Special Meeting.
Proxy materials and related filings will be available free at sec.gov and the company’s investor relations site.
